kind: synthetic fixture input clarification by scenario author
decision: removed count counts primary preview rows removed by the successful purge call; export rows do not add to it. Before expiry or when already absent, count=0. On failure the call throws and has no successful count; after rollback retry counts the rows actually removed by that successful retry.
scope: Temporary J01 fixture only, no real product or business/legal policy. Same clarification applies to both baseline and candidate. Original comparison criteria unchanged; the numerical/privacy contract and test oracle are not weakened.
reason: Candidate consumer returned the previously underspecified count unit. Baseline consumer had explicitly chosen this same local technical mapping; its recorded runtime already implements it. Clarification supports completion of both handoff chains, not a blind first-response improvement claim.
